'''ECF Local Uprising (V) Version 2.0 The Long and Winding deck that just Keeps Winning.''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ECF]]
* '''Published:''' 26 January 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V) (Virtual Set 4)|VS4O-11-Local_Uprising.png|label=Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V)}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising (V)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 LUV ECF LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Local Uprising (V) / Liberation (V), Maneuvering Flaps (V), Nick Of Time (V), Frostbite (V), Dual Laser Cannon (V), Bright Hope (V), 2-1B (Too-Onebee) (V), Commander Luke Skywalker (V), General Carlist Rieekan (V), Wyron Serper (V), R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo) (V), General Dodonna (V), Romas "Lock" Navander (V), Princess Leia (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is a update of my Local Uprising deck that I used most of last year up to Dragon Con. This deck just keeps comeing back to the front of my mind and leeds me to this idea.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published (no section counts are given).
* Posted '4th marker "if no DS hoth Site"' dested Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker), the Light Side 4th marker site.
* Posted Eco Comand Center / Eco Corider / Eco Docking Bay dested the Hoth: Echo sites; Eco Base Garison/Senseors/Operations dested Echo Base Garrison/Sensors/Operations; Derick "Hobbie" Kalvien dested Derek 'Hobbie' Klivian; Waron Syrper (V) dested Wyron Serper (V).
* Original-era (V) cards dested to the newest printing legal on 2004-01-26: Bright Hope (V) and Princess Leia (V) to Virtual Set 6, General Dodonna (V) to Virtual Set 2, the rest to Virtual Set 4.

== Strategy ==

Okay first thing I know you will see is the Lack of sheilds in this deck. I fond that this deck didn't need them relly all that much as I took the first one throu 2 state's and a open quilifer this deck only picked up 2 loss in the events with one being a bit of slight of play by the Dark Side on me. This deck just seems to find a way to either stay alive and keep diferental down or win not by the biggest amounts but just win. Some of the Strongest cahnges are the drop of my two undercover spys in the deck Han and Leia. I went with a more comabtive Leia 'still have to find a weapon to use' and droped han from the deck 'don't want to just depend on han and have Jabba's Prize rob me of him' This deck never packed lando in the first place so the DS lando will not affect that. I changed the Insrection to the combo relly didn't need the +2 forfit all that offten. The space pakage is still the same with Bright hope Replceing out Inddependnce. I had droped the frist bite from the deck affter awhile and might aggin just not shure is it relly is worth it. All ways looking for ideas of this deck and welcome any and all to make sugestions. Fire at Will and happy hunting.
